sections.Profile:
Shangri-La , released by Williams in March 1967, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by Christian Marche, in which players complete red, white and blue sets of 1-2-3 to light stars and the special. Its playfield features rotating targets, and 4,900 units were built.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Fictional Place, Travel, Single level playfield
